# Trace Help Center

> Complete support documentation for Trace's soccer video analysis and player development platform, covering PlayerFocus cameras, Trace iD highlights organization, and team management tools.

The Trace Help Center provides comprehensive guides for soccer teams and organizations using Trace's video capture, highlights, and recruiting tools. Documentation covers hardware setup, software features, account management, and best practices for game analysis and player development.

## Key Topics

- PlayerFocus
- Trace iD
- MultiCam
- Soccer highlights
- Camera setup
- Video management
- Recruiting tools
- Game search
- Subscription management
- Trace Teams app
- Getting started
- Equipment maintenance
- Highlights organization
- Player development
- TraceUp support

## Getting Started

- [Trace Help Center](https://support.traceup.com): Main help center hub for Trace products including PlayerFocus, Trace iD, and MultiCam
- [A Quick Guide to Your Trace Highlights](https://support.traceup.com/content/a-quick-guide-to-your-trace-highlights): Getting started guide for navigating, saving, and sharing Trace soccer highlights
- [Game search](https://support.traceup.com/content/game-search): Guide for searching and finding soccer games in Trace platform

## Camera Setup & Hardware

- [Activate Your Camera](https://support.traceup.com/content/activate-your-camera): Setup guide for activating and pairing PlayerFocus camera with Trace teams app
- [Uploading (PlayerFocus)](https://support.traceup.com/content/uploading-playerfocus): Setup and video upload guide for PlayerFocus camera with ethernet and power setup
- [Trace Weather Recommendations](https://support.traceup.com/content/trace-weather-recommendations): Equipment maintenance guide for Trace camera use in rain and windy conditions

## Trace iD & Highlights

- [Trace iD FAQs](https://support.traceup.com/content/trace-id-faqs): FAQs for Trace iD soccer highlights organization, sharing, and recruiting tools

## Account & Subscription Management

- [How to Update, Cancel, or Delete Your Subscription](https://support.traceup.com/content/how-to-update-cancel-or-delete-your-subscription): Guide for managing Pro/Basic subscription plans, billing, and account settings

## Support & Contact

- [Contact Us](https://support.traceup.com/content/contact-us): Contact information for TraceUp support, sales, and customer service inquiries
